notes: covered by dino8-kernel/tests/extra/rowwork3_blender_meshb_oracles.cpp; closed-form/oracle: an octahedron around the origin: equator vertices have v = 1/2 and u steps by 1/4 per quarter turn, the poles have v = 1 and 0, opposite equator vertices differ by half a turn; on an ico sphere v = 1/2 + latitude / pi and u differences equal azimuth differences / 2 pi at every vertex; documentation: Blender Manual, UV > Project from Sphere (docs.blender.org/manual/en/latest/modeling/meshes/uv/unwrapping/mapping_types.html) and bpy.ops.uv.sphere_project (docs.blender.org/api/current/bpy.ops.uv.html); the Blender seam position and pole orientation are not compared (definition paraphrased); the page text could not be fetched from this sandbox (network policy), so the definition is paraphrased from recollection and the sentence is not quoted; the Blender semantics used here are from recollection, needs owner/independent check; Tested: Mesh::ComputeSphericalMappingUVs (kernel projection about the bounding-box centre, pole +Z). Untested: the projection direction options (VIEW_ON_EQUATOR, VIEW_ON_POLES, ALIGN_TO_OBJECT), the clip / correct aspect / scale-to-bounds options, the restriction to selected faces, the position of u = 0 and the seam against Blender, and undo.

notes: covered by dino8-kernel/tests/extra/rowwork3_blender_meshb_oracles.cpp; closed-form/oracle: a flat regular hexagon fan (edge 1) in a tilted plane keeps all 12 edge lengths and the triangle area sqrt(3)/4, with the same winding; a cylinder strip r = 1, h = 2 over 180 degrees in 12 chord facets unrolls to a rectangle whose bottom edge : end rule = 24 sin(pi / 24) : 2 (width to height 1.56631), with the diagonals sqrt(w^2 + h^2) : h; documentation: Blender Manual, UV > Unwrap, Conformal method (docs.blender.org/manual/en/latest/modeling/meshes/uv/unwrapping/mapping_types.html) and bpy.ops.uv.unwrap (docs.blender.org/api/current/bpy.ops.uv.html); least-squares conformal maps, Levy et al., SIGGRAPH 2002 (definition paraphrased); the page text could not be fetched from this sandbox (network policy), so the definition is paraphrased from recollection and the sentence is not quoted; the Blender semantics used here are from recollection, needs owner/independent check; Tested: ComputeLscmUVs (the conformal method; this test is in addition to the existing LscmFlat / Cylinder / Cone tests). Untested: the Angle Based method (ABF), seam handling and cutting of closed meshes (ComputeLscmUVs refuses a closed mesh), pinned vertices, fill holes, correct aspect, margin, the island pack that follows an unwrap, selected-faces-only operation, and undo.
